interpretation: Eligibility is a supplied procedural result, not target performance or branch admission.
strict_limitations: Bindings test declared semantics, not faithful extraction or source applicability.
Hash commitments are not signatures against host-side alteration.
Legacy entrypoints remain unchanged; new controllers must explicitly use v1 without fallback.
No source-population reconstruction, weighting, measurement conversion or generator execution occurs.
Source precision, individual variation, Monte Carlo and transport uncertainty are not pooled.
qualified_limitations: Generated rows do not identify the original joint population or estimator preprocessing.
HbA1c scale conversion does not establish assay or specimen equivalence.
Original unknown weights and strict unavailability are preserved.
Point differences have no precision weights, CI pass rule, or transport interpretation.
Review hashes are procedural commitments, not verified identities or signatures.
